a-laddhā , neg. abs. of labhati ( q. v. ) , cf. a-latth[ā/a] above; SN l 126, 24* = 32* (aladdhă [ so metr. C.mss. †yo taṃ]; — alabhitvā, Spk); here †yo taṃ (yo ti nipātamattaṃ, Spk) may stand for a word meaning otāraṃ; Mvu lll 284, 2* -il* points to *alabdhv[ā/a] gā- haṃ or gāḍhaṃ (ɔ: gādhaṃ?).
